sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My truck broke down at the only stop light in this ghost town
I sure don't know where to go now, maybe find someone who knows how
The beauty of life carries on.
Guess I'll wallk it, won't be long now til I'm talking
To you about how the world's over, but I just want you to talk slower
So I can taste every last drop.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: And that's you babe, heaven in a glass on a tuesday
To you about how the world's over, but I just want you to talk slower
Still got the whole week to go.
And you're gorgeous, bigger than life in a moment
While I'm holding you tight, out of focus
Still got the whole week to go.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Things are changin, things don't seem to be what they've been
Things that I can't put a name to, things I've been thinkin I'd hate to
Find a bunch more of around.
But there's beauty, there's still a world, absolutely,
Invested in keeping its boots on, never too old for a new song,
And never too saddened to care.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Been a long day, maybe my heart needs a repave
Too many cars on the freeway, burnin a hole in my pocket
Bout as good as it gets.
That's something, you live and you learn that the hard winds
Are blowing forever until it all settles down and I knew it
Wouldn't be too hard for long.
